mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressures that lead to tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE spikes do not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% MoM signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST declines do not correlate with subsequent market downturns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increases do not correlate with subsequent market rallies.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real final sales (RSAFS) grow by less than 1% YoY and unemployment (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3% in the same period, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combined RSAFS and UNRATE conditions do not correlate with subsequent market downturns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increases do not correlate with subsequent market rallies.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows to less than 1% QoQ and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% YoY, it signals stagflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combined GDPC1 and CPIAUCSL conditions do not correlate with subsequent market downturns.
